more_info.uses: EU permissions include dried fruit and vegetables, other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets, chewing gum. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Maximum-permitted-use estimates were below the limit.
The limit used animal subchronic evidence; longer-term and reproductive studies were unavailable.
more_info.overview: Hydrogenated poly-1-decene is a synthetic hydrocarbon wax. It is used as a glazing ingredient on the surface of specified foods.
